description: This source file implements the MiracastPlayer plugin for a media application, including initialization, handling play/stop requests, setting video/audio formats, handling state changes, and communication via JSON-RPC. It also contains class definitions, method implementations, and internal logic specific to Miracast streaming management.

classes.name: MiracastPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing the Miracast streaming plugin handling requests, state management, and communication with the Miracast RTSP message handler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MiracastPlayer plugin, setting up instances and registering methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and shuts down the plugin.

methods.name: playRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to start Miracast streaming with specified device parameters and video rectangle.

methods.name: stopRequest
methods.description: Handles a request to stop Miracast streaming with a specified reason.

methods.name: setPlayerState
methods.description: Sets the current player state (e.g., PLAY, STOP, PAUSE).

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video sink rectangle dimensions.

methods.name: setRTSPWaitTimeout
methods.description: Configures RTSP request and response timeouts.

methods.name: setVideoFormats
methods.description: Configures supported video formats for Miracast.

methods.name: setAudioFormats
methods.description: Configures supported audio formats for Miracast.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked on a change in player state, notifies system or external components.
